structured_summary: In a quiet office, the NAO robot delivers a package. It first announces the delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the announcement (by speaking or nodding) within 8 seconds. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must then confirm the delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: How the robot detects a head nod acknowledgment
Exact speech content for the announcement and final confirmation
Behavior if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (timeout handling, retries, failure)
Any retry or repair logic for missed acknowledgment
potential_ambiguities: Whether acknowledgment via head nod is reliably detectable by the robot

Exact wording of the final confirmation message
Whether the quiet office environment imposes any noise constraints on speech recognition
